High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee errata card [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 2)]] (the earlier errata image marked "E"), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]]. strangewayes re-set the card for printing, so small details (fonts, colours, the gold "E" errata mark, some icons) differ from the Holotable image; the wording is that of this version.

This is a fan print-ready rendition of the wording documented on [[Commence Recharging (PC Errata 2)]], not a scan of that official source image. Its re-typeset text and line wrapping differ, and the gold E is inside the card rather than the official image's white E outside the lower-right frame. These rendition differences are not an additional published PC image version.

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Light_E/Commence Recharging _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1YioLoH-Ga_pZ-0EwrxDwc7mLSMc6VdfG/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Commence Recharging _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,344,300 bytes, SHA-256 <code>b6dad26a28230f1dfca8a10d75d9bf4073d928d77ce5f47f51688a07d23e12b0</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.0, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article is [[:File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-E-2018-07-08.gif]]; this fan rendition is linked there as a qualified comparison.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
